results.evidence_text: Dairy products, calcium and phosphorus intake, and the risk of prostate cancer: results of the French prospective SU.VI.MAX
results.one_sentence_explanation: The title and MeSH (Phosphorus / administration & dosage, adverse effects) establish that dietary phosphorus intake was evaluated against incident prostate cancer in a prospective human cohort, so the numerically unreported estimate does not justify S2-NO-TARGET-ESTIMATE and Claude+Gemini's INCLUDE is supported.
